title: aspilia fruticosa
intro: Aspilia fruticosa, commonly known as African tea tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a sought-after natural remedy. The therapeutic actions of Aspilia fruticosa are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, ease pain, and modulate immune responses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
